# OUR LEAF AND THE STORE [italic]Prices in UA dollars or colony scrip, at the co-op counter. Members pay at cost. Shipping to other colonies by the next freighter with room in the hold.[/italic]
## CO-OP GROWN
- [bold]Hope's Leaf[/bold], loose cured leaf, $3 the pouch. Mild, a little sweet, grown under the bay lamps at Hope's Retreat. - [bold]River Dark[/bold], loose cured leaf, $4 the pouch. Grown at Shepherds' Pride and cured in the damp. Strong. Made for a pipe. - [bold]Co-op Hand Rolls[/bold], $1 each. Unfiltered, rolled at the counter by whichever member is on shift. Quality varies with the member. - [bold]Briar Pipe[/bold], $15. Carved by a retired miner on Solaris Ridge. Every one slightly different. Some of them are quite a lot different.
## ROLL YOUR OWN
- [bold]Rolling papers[/bold], 50 cents the book. - [bold]Filters[/bold], 50 cents the bag. The co-op recommends them. Your lungs recommend them more. - [bold]Co-op matchbook[/bold], free with any pouch.
## FROM THE BIG BRANDS [italic]We stock what our members smoke. We do not have to like it.[/italic]
- [bold]Koorlander[/bold], $5. The colonial staple. Flat, dusty and dependable, like the terraforming crews that made it famous. - [bold]Arcturian Ace[/bold], $5. Bright blue packet. Popular with the young and the optimistic. - [bold]Sol Reds[/bold], $6. Claim to be all natural. So does our leaf, and ours is. - [bold]Emerald Greens[/bold], $4. The cheap one. We stock it so that nobody has to buy it from a smuggler.
## NOT STOCKED Koorlander Lady Fingers. Our members asked us to stop. One of them uses a pack to keep bugs out of his tent, and says it works, and that is all we have to say about them.
